jointEngineGaps: QB passing yards and the sum of teammate receiving yards are drawn INDEPENDENTLY per iteration (two Gamma draws) — gross passing = team receiving is not enforced; the published families never surfaced the contradiction because pass yds is withheld.
TD outcomes are not simulated inside the game draws at all (separate closed-form engine over team-TD distribution); player TDs cannot reconcile to team scores or to each other per draw.
Team score accounting has no kicks/defensive/return/conversion decomposition; offensive TDs are not forced to explain points (nothing decomposes at all).
Pace: volumes are margin-driven only (proven); no total->pace pathway exists.
